description: Search US STATE government spending / vendor payments — the 'checkbook' data of what an agency actually PAID a vendor (distinct from an awarded contract's value). Keyless. Filter by vendor, awarding agency, spending category keyword, and minimum amount. Pass a `jurisdiction` key (see gov_contracts_jurisdictions) to target one state, or omit it to search all covered states. Returns vendor, agency, amount, category, and fiscal year. Use gov_contracts_search for awarded contracts; use this for actual payments/expenditures.

jurisdiction.description: State key to target (e.g. "nj", "vt", "or", "md", "mo"). Omit to search all covered states.

keyword.description: Match against the spending category/description (case-insensitive substring).

min_amount.description: Only payments of at least this many dollars.

name: gov_spending_search
